body:
## Objective

Repair the repository-owned CI path after PR #110 merged a malformed ecosystem validation block and a stale governance manifest.

## Changes

- Replace the malformed DAIOF CI workflow with one deterministic validation path.
- Use the actual runtime APIs: `DigitalEcosystem(name=...)` and `simulate_time_step(0.1)`.
- Remove duplicate lifecycle, ecosystem, lint, and pytest execution.
- Add explicit assertions for organism health, ecosystem population, and simulation time.
- Add a one-time governed bootstrap that removes itself and regenerates `governance/workflow_manifest.json` from the final workflow tree.
- Add `docs/operations/POST_MERGE_CI_CLOSURE.md` with execution boundaries and acceptance gates.

## Execution boundary

- Branch-only changes; `main` was not edited directly.
- GitHub Actions is the remote verification oracle.
- Copilot and quota-bound agents are excluded from the critical path.
- No auto-merge. Human review remains mandatory.

## Acceptance gates

- Governance manifest validates with no drift.
- Repository-owned GitHub checks pass.
- No `simulate_generation` call remains.
- The one-time bootstrap workflow deletes itself before final review.
title: fix(ci): close post-merge governance and ecosystem validation
